articles.title: Show HN: Linkly – a language designed for LLMs, compiled through MLIR
articles.summary: A significant software development project, internally named "v0.1.0 Unfinished," has announced the successful completion of its initial phase. This achievement involved finalizing key technical components such as a custom MLIR dialect and the last agent role, and resolving all known limitations. The extensive work is underscored by hundreds of thousands of tests and numerous code integrations.
